verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents behavioral cohorts: it can create them, and the Behavioral Cohorts API can list, export and upload them. It also documents charts, dashboards and user segmentation, which covers the 'slice by behavioral cohorts' half of the story. No evidence in the pack mentions a retention chart or retention-over-time analysis, so the core retention measurement is only implied by the general charting and funnel claims. Missing for 10: explicit retention analysis documentation, evidence that retention charts can be broken down by cohort, independent or hands-on corroboration.
